form.label: Prusa Watch - Overview
form.description: AI watchdog for the Prusa MK3.5S: verdicts, alerts, printer telemetry, AI model, cost and energy.

search.query: index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" $job_filter$ | rex field=_raw "\"cost_usd\":\s*(?<cost_raw>[0-9.eE-]+)" | eval cost_usd=coalesce(cost_raw, if(isnotnull(input_tokens), round(input_tokens*1.10/1000000 + output_tokens*5.50/1000000, 6), null())) | fields _time type job_id state previous_state phase progress axis_z temp_nozzle target_nozzle temp_bed target_bed fan_hotend fan_print status issue confidence description part_visible evidence downgraded confirm_status streak action subject sent error component change_pct latency_ms input_tokens output_tokens cost_usd provider model has_expected

index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type IN (check, energy) | sort 0 _time | eval jid=job_id | filldown jid | search type=energy | stats latest(print_energy_kwh) as kwh latest(print_energy_cost) as energy_cost by jid | rename jid as job_id

index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=check job_id=* | stats min(_time) as start by job_id | sort - start | eval label="Job ".job_id." (".strftime(start,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").")", value="job_id=".job_id
index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" | stats max(_time) as last | eval minutes_ago=round((now()-last)/60) | fields minutes_ago
index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=heartbeat model=* | head 1 | eval model=provider.": ".model | fields model
index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=ai_check | head 1 | eval result=if(ok="true", "OK", "FAILED"), when=strftime(_time, "%d %b %H:%M") | fields result

single.option: key and model access at add-on start

search.query: index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=heartbeat version=* | head 1 | fields version
search type=check | stats count
search type=check status=failure | stats count
search type=email sent=true | stats count
search type=error | stats count
search type=check | stats sum(cost_usd) as usd | eval usd=round(usd,3)
stats sum(kwh) as kwh | eval kwh=round(kwh,2)
stats sum(energy_cost) as cost | eval cost=round(cost,2)
search type=check | timechart span=5m count by status
search type=check issue!=none | stats count by issue | sort - count
search type=check | timechart span=2m avg(temp_nozzle) as nozzle avg(target_nozzle) as nozzle_target avg(temp_bed) as bed avg(target_bed) as bed_target
search type=check | timechart span=2m max(progress) as progress_pct max(axis_z) as z_mm avg(fan_hotend) as hotend_fan_rpm avg(fan_print) as print_fan_rpm
search type=check | eval confidence_pct=confidence*100 | timechart span=5m avg(confidence_pct) as confidence_pct avg(change_pct) as frame_change_pct max(streak) as failure_streak

panel.title: How much of the part the model can see

search.query: search type=check part_visible=* | timechart span=10m count by part_visible

search (type=check status!=ok) OR type=email OR type=error OR (type=state state IN ("ERROR","ATTENTION","FINISHED","STOPPED")) | eval detail=coalesce(description, subject, error, "state ".previous_state." -> ".state) | eval confidence=if(isnotnull(confidence), round(confidence*100)."%", null()) | table _time type job_id progress status issue confidence part_visible confirm_status downgraded streak action model detail | sort - _time

index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=check job_id=* | rex field=_raw "\"cost_usd\":\s*(?<cost_raw>[0-9.eE-]+)" | eval cost_usd=coalesce(cost_raw, round(input_tokens*1.10/1000000 + output_tokens*5.50/1000000, 6)) | stats min(_time) as start max(_time) as last_check max(progress) as progress count as checks count(eval(status="warning")) as warnings count(eval(status="failure")) as failures sum(cost_usd) as ai_usd latest(model) as model by job_id | join type=left job_id [search index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type IN (check, energy) | sort 0 _time | eval jid=job_id | filldown jid | search type=energy | stats latest(print_energy_kwh) as kwh latest(print_energy_cost) as energy_eur by jid | rename jid as job_id] | eval duration=tostring(last_check-start, "duration"), start=strftime(start,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), ai_usd=round(ai_usd,3), model=replace(model, "^eu\.anthropic\.", "bedrock: ") | table job_id start duration progress checks warnings failures model ai_usd kwh energy_eur | sort - start

index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=check | rex field=_raw "\"cost_usd\":\s*(?<cost_raw>[0-9.eE-]+)" | eval cost_usd=coalesce(cost_raw, round(input_tokens*1.10/1000000 + output_tokens*5.50/1000000, 6)) | stats count as checks avg(cost_usd) as usd_per_check sum(cost_usd) as usd_total avg(latency_ms) as latency_ms avg(input_tokens) as tokens_in count(eval(status!="ok")) as non_ok count(eval(has_expected="true")) as with_thumbnail min(_time) as first_used max(_time) as last_used by model | eval usd_per_check=round(usd_per_check,5), usd_per_print_hour=round(usd_per_check*60,3), usd_total=round(usd_total,3), latency_ms=round(latency_ms), tokens_in=round(tokens_in), non_ok_pct=round(non_ok/checks*100,1), thumbnail_pct=round(with_thumbnail/checks*100), first_used=strftime(first_used,"%Y-%m-%d"), last_used=strftime(last_used,"%Y-%m-%d") | table model checks usd_per_check usd_per_print_hour usd_total latency_ms tokens_in non_ok_pct thumbnail_pct first_used last_used | sort - last_used

panel.title: AI cost per day by model

search.query: index=prusa_watch sourcetype="prusa:watch" type=check | rex field=_raw "\"cost_usd\":\s*(?<cost_raw>[0-9.eE-]+)" | eval cost_usd=coalesce(cost_raw, round(input_tokens*1.10/1000000 + output_tokens*5.50/1000000, 6)) | timechart span=1d sum(cost_usd) by model
search type=check | timechart span=10m avg(latency_ms) as latency_ms avg(input_tokens) as input_tokens
